exposure: Preconception severe hypoglycemia (PSH) stratified by frequency (no, sporadic, recurrent)
cohort: Women with pregestational Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) were included in this multicenter prospective study.
finding: Recurrent preconception severe hypoglycemia is significantly associated with increased risks of preeclampsia, preterm birth, neonatal hypoglycemia, neonatal hyperbilirubinemia, and composite neonatal outcome in pregnant women with T1DM.
